name: Rains County, TX
findings: Rains County has 29 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Rains County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
80% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Rains County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 76% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
